note: Every voidfx edit with its owner verdict, quotes, strengths and lessons. Studio 1 = v1-v11 (its own branch), Studio 2 = v101-v105. Verbatim Studio 2 messages: owner_messages_studio2.md.

edits.title: SURPRISE (first cut)
edits.look: night thriller, scope / barrel, glass shatter, chrome-red type
owner_notes: A sloppy, choppy opening; dialogue clips 'stuck together with Elmer's glue'
Name labels ('who is Doakes / who is Dexter'); a stamp under the captions
Text that just appears; TARGET ACQUIRED / I NEED IT 'off' and not pronounced
A constant watermark; an outro card that broke the loop
lessons: Dialogue plays as one continuous take
No labels, no stacked text
Every word eases in; big moments get big designed moves
Logo once as a transition; no outro card

edits.title: SURPRISE
strengths: dialogue-led cold open as one continuous take
barrel -> scope fly-through
pupil -> iris loop
fly through the logo's 'o' (original colours)
owner_notes: Rev: the BLEED IT animation was invisible or weak; a sloppy cut before 'What can I say'

edits.title: FASTEST
owner_notes: An explosion/starburst transition (rejected)
A title card 'THE FLASH: FASTEST MAN ALIVE' (rejected)
Slow-motion run-at-camera and floating shots (rejected)
Generic lyric words; a wrong lyric ('think a thing' for 'feel a thing')
Falling letters that weren't cool enough
lessons: No generic bursts unless physical and themed
No title cards
Cut weak footage even if on theme
Verify lyrics on the isolated vocal and the official lyrics
Detailed multi-stage text animation
liked: lyric keywords whose animation acts out the meaning (FALLING drops, FADING dissolves, DROWNING ripples)

edits.title: WARMPOP
edits.look: pastel vapor + VHS (chroma bleed, scanlines, CRT, neon)
owner_quotes: wonderful transitions, animations, graphics, while maintaining the style that I like … I like how the music correlates to the edit. I like the text.
owner_notes: Japanese subtitle lines (removed as clutter)
The VHS 'SP 0:00:10' timer (removed)
strengths: one concept ('a VHS Miami daydream: he disappears, the tape rewinds')
biggest transition on the song's biggest moment
15+ designed transitions, no plain cuts
character's own words as two-line eased captions
depth graphics: vapor-world tune-in behind the matte, palm shadows, bokeh, neon spill, VHS pause
approved transitions: CRT fly-through, cube, sun stripes, film strip

edits.title: HIM ALL ALONG
edits.look: forensic noir (drained cold colour, blood red only, UV luminol, case-file type)
owner_quotes: The transitions were creative and well animated.
owner_notes: Rapid dialogue run 'Dramatic. Cryptic. Playful.' (cut)
A talking 'jar of blood' shot: 'pointless, especially with him talking'
The ending where Dexter just says he's a serial killer
STAY STRONG + red strings converging on his face with a target ring (no gimmick overlays on the face)
The voidfx logo turned blue (never restyle the logo)
Plain steel doors for CLOSE (fixed with a rosewood blood-slide box with an engraved brass plate)
strengths: blood-slide box
plastic burst on the drop
body-bag zipper
blood on the lens
M99 blink
magnifier -> pupil loop
evidence markers and the CASE CLOSED stamp
'Could it be him?' answered by the hook HIM ALL ALONG

edits.title: WISH YOU WELL
edits.look: sodium nocturne (indigo shadows, sodium-vapour highlights, rain on glass, streetlight sweeps)
edits.verdict: liked: 'I think it did most things well'
liked: the 'Darling,' freeze: comma swells into a blood drop that falls with Dexter refracted inside and blooms in water on the drop
the basic transitions: streetlight sweep, wiper, whip pans, plastic wrap, impact negative, rain focus pull, lamp on, one cut per syllable on the hook
owner_notes: Text appearance disliked: thin wide-tracked sans, serif-italic emphasis, letter-by-letter fades, underlines, extruded words behind his head, elegant script

edits.title: NIGHT BLOOM
edits.window: h448-h506 + h634-h650, spliced on the 4-bar cycle
edits.hero_moment: 2:19.38 dead silence -> freeze; 2:20.84 drop -> petal bloom
edits.look: moonbloom (violet-black night, moon-silver highlights, Pro-Mist bloom, jasmine petals, a blood moon)
edits.verdict: 'good… complete' but lacklustre; the text was 'perfect' and became the standard text style
lessons: Root the concept in the character's world, not the song title
At least three multi-stage character-themed set pieces
More depth graphics in the montage
Compare the plan with v6/v7/v8 before building ('go above and beyond')

edits.title: LET IT HAPPEN
owner_quotes: I like this edit and would like for you to make it a standard.
strengths: velocity ramps on every hook shot (a burst on each beat, optical-flow slow motion between, on restored 2x source)
camera moving with the music (zoom punches, rotation kicks, hit-frame blur)
light rays from the lightning
multi-stage set pieces (emblem dive into the drop wave, time particles, lens shatter, lightning branches, perimeter lap, phase, whirlwind)
bullet time in frozen holds
lyric text on sung onsets
the AROUND ring loop back to frame 0
lessons: Two rounds of 'lacklustre' were fixed by the motion pass, not by more effects
Restore 720p sources (tools/sr_prep.py)

edits.title: BOP
edits.verdict: approved standard (rev 4): concept, focal set piece, loop; Studio 1's base engine
owner_quotes: I like this edit and would like for you to make it a standard.
strengths: concept from the song's own words ('Harrison' -> the Reverse-Flash rivalry; red vs gold grades)
two designed titles only (LET'S GO, BOP) for explicit lyrics
THE RIFT focal set piece
detailed procedural emblem revealed by a coin flip on the real chest emblem
beat moments instead of just moving to the beat (aura, time remnants, charge-up)
loop lands on frame 0 (seam 0.11)
flash discipline (rim flash from mean luma 178 to 104)

edits.title: THE LESS YOU KNOW
edits.song: Tame Impala "The Less I Know The Better"
edits.look: 16 mm psychedelic reel (oxblood/amber/plum liquid light, film burn, 70s soft-serif type)
edits.verdict: rejected style: 'I do not like this edit … I largely disliked the style'; some transitions good
owner_notes: A narrated line shown as if spoken where his lips didn't move
lessons: Only present a line as spoken when his lips match it (tools/lipcheck.py)
Don't reuse the 16 mm psychedelic look

edits.title: LET GO
edits.look: storm (crimson suit, gold lightning, steel-blue shadows)
lessons: Concept from his world, not the lyric
More standout set pieces
Graphics must read at phone size

edits.title: FOREVER
edits.window: h1000-h1080 + h1096-h1152 (two riff bars spliced out)
edits.look: undertow (teal-black water, bone highlights, blood the only warm colour)
owner_quotes: I like this edit. I would like for you to make it a standard. I just have one note. I would like for there to be more animations and transitions moving forward and that lyric kind of recognition to happen.
set_pieces: THE RIP (plastic tears open on the drop)
THE EVIDENCE PHOTOS (ring flash on 'IF', photo toss)
THE GULF STREAM (loop sinks and surfaces in the same water)
owner_notes: Rev 1: VO's last word cut off; a low-quality shot; captions where the song wasn't singing
Rev 2-4: blood slides that stick around; random blood drips; the knife slicing across; the drawn slide animation; glass shatter and duct-tape strips
Clarified: 'I didn't necessarily hate the blood slide or the knife across the screen, I just don't like how it looked in this specific edit'
lessons: Props are fine when motivated, brief, physically lit, in the edit's look, off the face
Text only on clearly sung/spoken words (tools/lyrics.py)
24+ transitions per ~24 s, beat camera everywhere

edits.title: THE PASSENGER
edits.song: GLM-RST "still love you (super slowed + reverb)" (TikTok sound, screen-recorded)
owner_quotes: I really like what you did with Dexter being upside down and that transition.
I really like this edit and would like for it to be a standard. Only gripe I have is that one span of the edit had some headspace that definitely could have had an edit or a cool transition.
lessons: No headspace: nothing longer than ~1 s without a cut, transition or designed beat
Rotation motif (roll into upside-down) was the favourite

edits.title: DRACULA
edits.hero_moment: 2:40.8 drop-out -> SUNDOWN; 2:42.9 drop (+29.8 dB) -> THE BAT BURST
edits.look: SUNDOWN: bleached warm day with the sun behind him / cold moonlit night with crimson
edits.verdict: approved standard after rev 3 (newest Studio 2 standard)
owner_quotes: I like the edit but what happened with the sun and the top right part of dexters head?
I would like for you to improve the transition/loop at the end and make it a more creative and unique transition.
I like this edit and would like for you to make it a standard. The only gripe I have is the quality of some of the clips.
set_pieces: THE BAT BURST + per-letter DRACULA into bats
lessons: Light sources go behind the subject (matte + light wrap)
Clip quality: check sharpness, avoid zoom on 720p, prefer high-bitrate packs, restore sources (sr_prep)
Library transitions carry old looks; restyle them per edit
